notes: Source: Fairchild Channel F (Video Entertainment System) manual, archive.org Fairchild-Channel-F-Manual. Quotes are verbatim lines of archive.org's OCR text (the item's _djvu.txt) of the maker's scanned manual, OCR errors and spacing included; the scan, not the OCR, is the authority, and a human should re-read each line against the page image. The manual describes the Hand-Controller's motions (Forward and Backward, Left and Right, «Rotates Right and Left», «Pulls Up and Plunges Down», and 45° diagonals) and its knob with «the recessed triangle on the knob», but gives no counted control list, so controls is an uncovered [] (the single knob is the plan's cap_handle, which has no contract kind yet). Whether the controllers are hardwired is not stated in a citable line: wired null. Body dimensions, mass, cord length: no maker or museum figure found, null.
